notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes: [p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621886/aff759e634bb48a5dbada697b13e0a94e855e670.png"][/img]Thank you sooooo much to everyone who played the game.[/h3][p]I am a solo game developer, so I apologize for any bad parts of the game.[/p][p]I looked at all the videos about the game on [b]YouTube[/b] and [b]fixed[/b] some [b]bugs[/b] that I missed and improved the gameplay a little.[/p][list][*][p][b]Garbage bags[/b] bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Auto [b]game save[/b] added[/p][/*][*][p]Added \[[b]K[/b]] and \[[b]U[/b]] buttons for quiting game and delete save progress[/p][/*][*][p][b]Continue button[/b] added to the menu at the start of the game[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]I have started working on a [b][i]new game[/i][/b] now, and this time the story will shock you even more. [b]Thank you very much again[/b].[/p]
